text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, oseltamivir phosphate is not on FDA's drug shortage list. Corvale East holds 233 capsules of 75 mg (17.1 days) and 331 capsules of 45 mg (21.1 days). Corvale General holds 297 capsules of 75 mg (18.2 days) and 341 capsules of 45 mg (21.3 days). Corvale Lakeside holds 47 capsules of 75 mg (14.6 days).

Why (FDA record): FDA's records show oseltamivir phosphate is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory across three sites provides 14.6 to 21.3 days of supply depending on location and strength. The top-ranked procurement option is Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc., which is not on FDA's shortage list today, but its label names no plant we could place. A registered relabeler, Preferred Pharmaceuticals Inc., has received VAI classifications in inspections ending 2009-12-30, 2015-10-29, 2018-01-29, 2020-01-14, and 2025-05-27.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to verify Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc. supply availability and confirm the manufacturing site for the product label; requires P&T committee approval.
2. Buyer to evaluate Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited as a secondary source and confirm its manufacturing site; requires P&T committee approval.
3. Buyer to assess Alvogen Inc., Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC, and Amneal Pharmaceuticals NY LLC for supply continuity and label transparency; requires P&T committee approval.

Not recommended: No changes to clinical ordering or dosing protocols at this time.
